title: dk-quickstart-recipe-1.0
description: Schema for a dk0 quickstart recipe. Recipes are fetched at run time from a registry; adding or updating a group does not require releasing a new dk0 binary.

schema_version.description: Version of the dk-quickstart schema used by this recipe.

name.description: The recipe name, matching the NAME in 'dk0 quickstart GROUP NAME' and the filename stem (<name>.quickstart.jsonc). The GROUP namespace is not stored in the recipe; it is encoded in the registry URL path.

imports.description: List of workspace imports. Each object's fields are passed verbatim as the attributes of a '%% import { ... }' directive in the generated dk.u.

type.description: Import type. 'github-l2' fetches from a GitHub release with SLSA attestation; 'local' reads a local values.json file.

tag.description: For type=github-l2: the release tag to import. If omitted, the latest release is used.

host.description: For type=github-l2: the GitHub host (defaults to 'github.com').

path.description: For type=local: path to the values.json file.

trust.description: Optional list of trust statements the quickstart records before scaffolding, each mirroring 'dk0 trust accept PACKAGE [--key PUBKEY] [--run] [--write]'. The engine prints every statement (interactive sessions confirm once before anything is recorded), records each as a durable acceptance in the new workspace's etc/dk/t/acceptances.json, and the same statements are rendered on the quickstart's page on diskuv.com. Engines that predate this field ignore it.

accept.description: The package whose producer key is accepted (PACKAGE_ID full name).

key.description: The pinned producer public key: the base64 line of the OpenBSD signify public key. Strongly recommended; an import whose key differs from the pin is denied, so a compromised package repository fails loudly instead of being accepted on first use.

capabilities.description: Pending request.ui capabilities ('run', 'write') that resolve into producer-key grants at the first verified import. List only the capabilities the package's rules need; key acceptance alone confers none.

seed_files.description: Optional list of additional files to create in the workspace directory after writing dk.u.

path.description: Strictly relative path within the workspace directory where the file is written.

content.description: Text content to write to the file.

next_steps.description: Human-readable message printed after the workspace is initialised, telling the user what to do next. This third-party text is also rendered on diskuv.com, so HTML-significant characters ('<', '>', '&'), BIDI overrides, and invisible/control characters (other than tab, newline, carriage return) are rejected.
